handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex while Codex2 completes higher-priority work.
Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Kraken execution adapter, CoinGecko reference client, crypto data-plane helpers, and Kraken canonical LEAN symbol mapping landed. Tests passed: services/execution/test_kraken_adapter.py, services/execution/test_ibkr_adapter.py, services/execution/test_shioaji_adapter.py, services/research/adapters/test_adapters.py, services/data-plane/tests/test_data_plane_schemas.py.

Reviewer found a blocking mismatch in the new CoinGecko->Kraken path: normalize_asset() emits asset symbols like BTC, but join_kraken_quote_with_reference() looks up pair symbols like BTCUSD and fails on real output. See docs/reviews/2026-04-24-app-003-datasource-crypto-001-codex-review.md.

Fixed the CoinGecko->Kraken join mismatch by resolving Kraken quote pairs through their base asset before reference lookup, so CoinGecko normalize_asset() output with symbol=BTC now joins truthfully to BTCUSD quotes. Regression coverage now uses real CoinGeckoClient.normalize_asset() output instead of a synthetic BTCUSD metadata row. Verified with: python3 -c reproduction -> coingecko_id=bitcoin; python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v; python3 -m unittest services.research.adapters.test_adapters services.execution.test_kraken_adapter -v (78 tests passed).

Symbol join fix verified, but KrakenAdapter.normalize_quote() still emits 'last' while join_kraken_quote_with_reference() reads 'close'; direct adapter->join repro yields quote_close=None. Align that payload contract and add regression coverage using KrakenAdapter.normalize_quote(...).to_dict().

Aligned Kraken normalize_quote payload contract so adapter snapshots emit both last and close, and added adapter->join regression coverage using KrakenAdapter.normalize_quote(...).to_dict(). Verified with python3 -m unittest services.execution.test_kraken_adapter -v and python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v.

Reviewer returning task to owner: adapter->join price propagation is fixed, but KrakenAdapter.normalize_quote still overwrites a payload-provided close with last when both are present. See docs/reviews/2026-04-24-app-003-datasource-crypto-001-codex-review.md for reproduction and required regression coverage.

Preserved distinct Kraken payload last/close semantics in normalize_quote() while keeping single-field fallback behavior, and added regressions at both adapter and adapter->join boundaries using KrakenAdapter.normalize_quote(...).to_dict(). Verified with python3 -m unittest services.execution.test_kraken_adapter services.research.adapters.test_adapters services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v (80 tests) plus the reviewer repro now returns quote_last=64321.1, quote_close=64320.4, joined_quote_close=64320.4.
Reviewer re-approval: distinct Kraken last/close semantics now preserved end-to-end, targeted suites rerun cleanly, and task is ready for owner finalization.
